tools.name: storyboard_get_state
tools.description: The open storyboard project: name, brief, aspect ratio, duration, model, characters, shots and the project list.

tools.name: storyboard_export_json
tools.description: The open project as the storyboard's JSON export (shots, characters, aspect ratio, duration). Returned as data; nothing is downloaded.

tools.name: storyboard_set_brief
tools.description: Set the project brief (the story idea).

tools.name: storyboard_set_project_name
tools.description: Rename the open project.

tools.name: storyboard_set_aspect_ratio
tools.description: Set the aspect ratio.

tools.name: storyboard_set_episode_duration
tools.description: Set the total episode length in seconds.

tools.name: storyboard_set_model
tools.description: Choose the image model the storyboard uses for shots.

tools.name: storyboard_add_shot
tools.description: Add a shot (scene description and length in seconds).

tools.name: storyboard_update_shot
tools.description: Change a shot's scene, duration or characters.

tools.name: storyboard_move_shot
tools.description: Move a shot from one position to another (0-based).

tools.name: storyboard_remove_shot
tools.description: Remove a shot.

tools.name: storyboard_add_character
tools.description: Add a character (name, optional description, optional reference image https URL).

tools.name: storyboard_update_character
tools.description: Change a character.

tools.name: storyboard_remove_character
tools.description: Remove a character.

tools.name: storyboard_create_project
tools.description: Start a new storyboard project (the current one stays in the project list).

tools.name: storyboard_switch_project
tools.description: Open another saved storyboard project.

tools.name: storyboard_delete_project
tools.description: Delete a saved storyboard project.

storyboard.notExposed: Shot image/video generation (covered by the generation tools), and the PDF/GIF downloads (need the browser file dialog).

tools.name: motion_director_get_project
tools.description: The Motion Director project: tracks, clips (card, timing, position, props), selection, playhead and undo depth.

tools.name: motion_director_command
tools.description: Say what to change in plain English ("make the title red", "add a lower third"); the studio's own Motion Agent turns it into real edits. Returns what it did.

tools.name: motion_director_add_clip
tools.description: Add a card to the timeline.

tools.name: motion_director_update_clip_props
tools.description: Change a clip's card properties (text, colours…).

tools.name: motion_director_update_clip
tools.description: Change a clip's timing or layer (start, duration, opacity, scale, x, y).

tools.name: motion_director_remove_clip
tools.description: Remove a clip from the timeline (undo brings it back).

tools.name: motion_director_set_background
tools.description: Set the stage background colour (hex).

tools.name: motion_director_select_clip
tools.description: Select a clip (the next command acts on it first).

tools.name: motion_director_set_playhead
tools.description: Move the playhead to a frame.

tools.name: motion_director_undo
tools.description: Undo the last change.

tools.name: motion_director_redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone change.

motion-director.notExposed: Dragging on the timeline, player scrubbing beyond the playhead, and rendering/export to a file (needs the browser renderer and a download).

tools.name: layers_get_state
tools.description: Layers Studio: the source image, options and the decomposed layers (with visibility).

tools.name: layers_set_image
tools.description: Use an image (public https URL) as the source.

tools.name: layers_set_options
tools.description: Set decomposition options: prompt, resolution (1K, 1.5K, 2K), output format and layer count.

tools.name: layers_decompose
tools.description: Split the source image into layers (paid generation). Optionally pass a prompt to describe the layers.

tools.name: layers_upscale
tools.description: Upscale the source image with the studio's upscaler settings (paid generation).

tools.name: layers_remove_background
tools.description: Remove the source image background (paid generation).

tools.name: layers_set_layer_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide one decomposed layer.

layers.notExposed: Freehand drawing, lasso/region/shape/brush tools, drag and zoom, text and colour-grade sliders and the canvas undo/redo work on pointer events over a canvas and have no programmatic surface.

tools.name: app_state
tools.description: Which studio is open in this tab and which studios exist.

tools.name: app_navigate
tools.description: Open a studio in this tab (ids from app_state). Studios with tab tools (storyboard, motion-director, layers) offer them while open.

app.notExposed: Opening modals, settings and saving API keys: only a person may do those.

notExposed.edit: The Edit playground form (tool, model and upload slots) is not driven from a tab: the same tools run server-side through edit_tool_run, no tab needed.
